final_message:
Partial refunds work through all three entry points. The full test suite (25 tests, including one new partial-refund test) and mypy both pass.

- **`refunds.refund_invoice`**: it takes an optional `amount` and refunds oldest payments first. A payment becomes `partially_refunded`, or `refunded` once it is used up, and each call creates one credit note with `refunded=True`. An amount of 0 or less, or one above what remains refundable, raises `ValidationError`. The check happens before any gateway call.
- **No amount**: it refunds whatever money remains, so after partial refunds it refunds only the remainder. Applied account credit is returned once, using a ledger entry with reason `refund` to tell whether it already went back. If nothing remains, it raises `InvalidStateError`.
- **`BillingEngine.refund` and `POST /invoices/{id}/refund`**: both accept the optional `amount`. The API rejects a non-integer `amount` with a `ValidationError`.

The old rule that any existing credit note blocked a refund is gone, since several partial refunds now have to be allowed. A `credit_invoice` note on the same invoice therefore no longer blocks a later refund. The refundable amount is based only on the paid money.

I also wrote `answer.json` in the repo root.

steps.command: git ls-files && cat billing/refunds.py && grep -n "refund" -r billing --include=*.py | grep -v "^billing/refunds.py"
grep -rn "refund" billing tests | grep -v "^billing/refunds.py"; cat billing/payments.py; grep -n "Payment\b" -A15 billing/models.py | head -40

cat billing/ledger.py; sed -n 85,105p billing/api.py; grep -n "_optional\|^def _" billing/api.py | head -20; sed -n 125,135p billing/engine.py; grep -n "ledger\|class LedgerEntry" -A8 billing/models.py | head -30
sed -n 15,40p billing/api.py; grep -n "def ledger_for\|def payments_for_invoice" -A6 billing/store.py
sed -i 's/^from .models import CurrencyCode,/from .models import Cents, CurrencyCode,/' billing/api.py && grep -n "^from .models" billing/engine.py

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='billing/api.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("from .models import CurrencyCode,","from .models import Cents, CurrencyCode,",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "^from .models" -A3 billing/engine.py

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='billing/engine.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("from .models import (\n    Clock,","from .models import (\n    Cents,\n    Clock,",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; .venv/bin/python -m mypy billing | tail -5
cat tests/test_credit_notes.py | head -20; grep -n "def \|fixture" tests/conftest.py | head -30

cat >> tests/test_credit_notes.py <<'EOF'


def _paid_invoice(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert inv["status"] == "paid"
    return inv


def test_partial_refunds(world):
    from billing.errors import InvalidStateError, ValidationError

    inv = _paid_invoice(world)
    paid = inv["amount_due"]
    [payment] = world.ctx.store.payments_for_invoice(inv["id"])
    note = world.engine.refund(inv["id"], amount=100)
    assert note["amount"] == 100 and note["refunded"]
    assert payment["status"] == "partially_refunded"
    for bad in (0, -1, paid):
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
            world.engine.refund(inv["id"], amount=bad)
    rest = world.engine.refund(inv["id"])
    assert rest["amount"] == paid - 100
    assert payment["status"] == "refunded"
    with pytest.raises(InvalidStateError):
        world.engine.refund(inv["id"])
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -8; .venv/bin/python -m mypy billing | tail -2
echo '{"summary": "Added optional partial-refund amounts to refund_invoice, BillingEngine.refund and the refund API, refunding oldest payments first with partially_refunded/refunded statuses and one credit note per refund."}' > answer.json

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='tests/test_credit_notes.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''    paid = inv["amount_due"]
    [payment] = world.ctx.store.payments_for_invoice(inv["id"])
''','''    [payment] = world.ctx.store.payments_for_invoice(inv["id"])
    paid = payment["amount"]
''').replace("for bad in (0, -1, paid):","for bad in (0, -1, paid + 1):")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -4; .venv/bin/python -m mypy billing | tail -1
